essence: Through sustained practice, a person's speech indeed becomes variegated.
By knowing this, even Dvaipāyana became the sage Veda Vyāsa.
By reciting twelve hundred thousand times, even a mute person would become a lord of speech.
After that, one should further meditate upon the goddess Vāgīśvarī.
Having meditated thus in non-difference with the self, one should then worship in due order.
